name: 🎨 Draw It!
desc:
🎨 Try to guess what the artist is drawing! Once the artist chooses a word, players have to guess what the word is before the timer runs out.

🛍️ Spend points on wallpapers and emoji reactions in the shop!
❤️ Tip artists points by tapping the 🤣 button and adding a reaction!
👑 Get the VIP Pass for a chat tag, extra time to draw, and more!

Remember to follow the Roblox Community Guidelines when using the in-game chat and art canvas.
⚠️ Tap the 🏳️ red flag to vote to skip the artist and hide the canvas.
⚠️ Report chats with "!report (person) (reason)" and mute players by blocking them.

📢 Play Draw It 2: https://www.roblox.com/games/18539339082/Draw-It-2
